resources.string: Copy settings, keys, firmware, saves, installed content, mods, and game folders from Eden or a compatible Yuzu-based emulator.

Choose an installed emulator, its user folder, or a full user-data ZIP backup. Compatible settings, keys, firmware, installed content, mods, and a snapshot of saves will be copied. You can then choose to use existing game, update/DLC, and save folders or keep independent copies. Android will ask you to grant folder access. Private app preferences and features unique to another emulator may not transfer. Close the source emulator before importing.
This replaces current Eden Duo settings, saves, and user data. A backup of the current data will be kept here so you can restore it. The source emulator and its files will remain unchanged.
User data copied. Select any separate folders listed below to copy or use in place, or skip them, before importing. You can also add game or update/DLC folders.
This folder and its files will not be imported. Its folder reference will be removed from the imported settings.
Select the root user folder of %1$s in the file picker.
Close the running game and its settings before importing data.
Copy cancelled. Current Eden Duo data was not changed.
Import complete. Previous Eden Duo data was backed up. Any folders you skipped were not imported.
Previous Eden Duo data restored. The data you replaced was backed up.
How should Eden Duo use this folder?
Copy files into Eden Duo (uses extra storage)
Use existing folder (keeps files in place)
Select a separate game or update/DLC folder and allow permanent read access.
Bring your settings and data from an existing emulator, or start fresh to set up keys, firmware, and games.

Use existing folder keeps files where they are. Eden Duo opens that folder directly, so changes are shared with the other emulator. Copy files makes a separate copy inside Eden Duo and uses extra storage.
Settings, keys, firmware, installed NAND content, and mods are always copied so Eden Duo has its own app data.

Use existing folder shares saves with the source emulator. Progress and deletions in either app affect the same saves. Keep the source emulator closed while playing. Copy files keeps an independent set of saves inside Eden Duo.
Select the save-storage root containing the user and system folders, usually the source emulator\'s nand folder.
This data must be copied into Eden Duo: settings, keys, firmware, installed NAND content, and mods. Game, update/DLC, and save folders can be shared separately.
Select a save-storage folder and allow permanent read and write access.
